baseline_weights_equal.sql: select a.version,a.valid_from,a.weights_json,a.weights_json=b.weights_json weights_equal from model_versions a join model_versions b on a.version=b.version where a.model_id='LEGACY_V18' and b.model_id='LEGACY_V18_BASE' order by a.version

weights_applied.sql: select distinct s.cohort_id,s.model_id,s.model_version,v.valid_from,v.weights_json from scores s join model_versions v on s.model_id=v.model_id and s.model_version=v.version where s.track='legacy' order by s.cohort_id,s.model_id

champion_challenger_equality.sql: select count(*) joined_rows,sum(a.final IS NOT b.final) different_final,sum(a.rank IS NOT b.rank) different_rank from scores a join scores b on a.cohort_id=b.cohort_id and a.security_id=b.security_id where a.model_id='EW_HIER_v1' and b.model_id='IC_SHRUNK_v1'

top15.sql: select s.rank,(select nse_symbol from symbol_history h where h.security_id=s.security_id order by h.valid_from desc limit 1) nse_symbol,s.sector_group,s.final,s.eligible from scores s where s.cohort_id='live:2026-09-30' and s.model_id='EW_HIER_v1' and s.rank<=15 order by s.rank

disputed_ranking_rows.sql: select s.model_id,s.rank,h.nse_symbol,s.final from scores s join (select distinct security_id,nse_symbol from symbol_history) h on s.security_id=h.security_id where s.cohort_id='live:2026-09-30' and h.nse_symbol in ('CHAMBLFERT','GLENMARK','TORNTPHARM','AUROPHARMA','COROMANDEL','CESC','FEDERALBNK') order by s.model_id,s.rank

WHERE s.cohort_id=? AND s.model_id=? AND l.horizon_m=? AND l.status='ok'
